title: Good truncation of a universally connective finite projective complex
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and P a bounded cochain complex of finite projective R-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Suppose termwise scalar extension to every commutative R-algebra has zero negative homology. There is a bounded finite projective complex Q with zero negative terms and a homotopy equivalence P -> Q. No hypothesis on degree-zero homology is required.

source.place: Tag 00O0 fixed-affine negative-tail argument; Mathlib good truncation at zero and IsKProjective.quasiIso_iff

proof.text: Define Q = P.truncGE 0. Its negative terms are zero, its zeroth term is P.opcycles 0, and its positive terms are those of P. Apply the opcycles criterion to the residue-field tests. Transfer finite projectivity termwise; an upper bound max(b,0) and lower bound zero give finite support.

The identity algebra test, transported through extendScalarsId, gives zero negative homology of P. Hence P -> Q is a quasi-isomorphism by the good-truncation criterion. Both complexes are bounded above with projective terms and thus K-projective. The Lean proof directly applies Mathlib IsKProjective.quasiIso_iff to the projection to obtain the homotopy equivalence; no library derived-map representative theorem is used.

lean.statement:
theorem universalConnective_projective_model
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ)
    (hb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n))
    (hf : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite R (P.X n))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective R (P.X n))
    (hnegative : ∀ (B : Type v) [CommRing B] (φ : R →+* B),
      let PB := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
      ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (PB.homology i)) :
    ∃ Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (Q.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite R (Q.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective R (Q.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 → IsZero (Q.X n)) ∧
      Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv P Q)
